Thanks for the ping. From Partner Ops side we can support two activation paths:

A) API-based issuance (preferred):
- CloudHatch POSTs to /partner/v1/vouchers with minimal payload (partner_id, external_ref, email, timestamp)
- Our system returns a voucher token and redemption metadata.
- We validate attribution via utm/partner_id on signup and automatically attach token to new account.

B) CSV bulk upload (fallback):
- Template: voucher_id, partner_id, email, issue_date, expiry_date, value, remarks
- Upload to S3 + we run ingestion job to create tokens.

Acceptance criteria before go-live:
- Rate limits: 60 req/min per partner API key
- Monthly cap enforcement at issuance time with alerting if partner reaches 80% cap
- Audit log entries for each issued token (for SOC/compliance requests)
- A sample activation CSV returned to CloudHatch for test cases (attached)

I've attached a sample CSV and a rough runbook for onboarding. We will need legal to sign off on the partner terms (CloudHatch provided) and product to add a partner attribution flag on the account resource.

Attachments: voucher-sample-activation.csv (CSV, 1KB)

Marcus Lin
